description: Summary figure: ALPP vs ALPL active-site conservation, structural superposition, primate conservation, and the identity of the three active-site differences
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.colors import ListedColormap
reg=pd.read_csv("out/region_conservation.csv")
sup=pd.read_csv("out/plap_tnap_superposition.csv")
prim=pd.read_csv("out/primate_active_site_conservation.csv")
shell=pd.read_csv("out/active_site_shell_comparison.csv")

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(13.5,8.6))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(2,2,height_ratios=[1,1.15],hspace=.42,wspace=.26)

# (a) regional identity ALPP vs ALPL
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,0])
o=["6A shell","10A shell","crown domain 366-430","rest of molecule"]
lab=["active site\n≤6 Å (n=26)","active site\n≤10 Å (n=66)","crown domain\n366-430 (n=65)","rest of chain\n(n=350)"]
vals=[reg.set_index("region").loc[k,"pct_id"] for k in o]
bars=ax.bar(lab,vals,color=["#1b6ca8","#4c9bd1","#d1884c","#9e9e9e"])
ax.axhline(57.8,ls="--",c="k",lw=1); ax.text(3.35,59,"whole chain 57.8%",ha="right",fontsize=8)
for b,v in zip(bars,vals): ax.text(b.get_x()+b.get_width()/2,v+1.2,f"{v:.0f}%",ha="center",fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel("% identity, ALPP vs ALPL"); ax.set_ylim(0,100)
ax.set_title("a  The ALPP active site is conserved with TNAP;\n    the crown domain is not (Fisher p=7e-4 and p=0.59)",fontsize=10,loc="left")
ax.tick_params(axis="x",labelsize=8)

# (b) superposition deviations
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,1])
s6=sup[sup.shell=="<=6A"].sort_values("PLAP_mature")
cols=["#c0392b" if not s else "#1b6ca8" for s in s6["same"]]
ax.bar(range(len(s6)),s6.CA_dev_A,color=cols)
ax.set_xticks(range(len(s6)))
ax.set_xticklabels([f"{a}{b}" for a,b in zip(s6.PLAP_aa,s6.PLAP_mature)],rotation=90,fontsize=7)
ax.set_ylabel("Cα deviation after superposition (Å)")
ax.set_title("b  PLAP (1EW2) vs human TNAP (7YIW): 66 active-site Cα, RMSD 0.31 Å\n     red = residue identity differs (G93, S155, E429)",fontsize=10,loc="left")
ax.grid(alpha=.3,axis="y")

# (c) primate conservation heatmap
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,0])
spcols=[c for c in prim.columns if c not in ("PLAP_mature","human_aa","role","in_6A_shell","n_conserved","n_primates")]
Mx=np.array([[1 if prim.loc[i,c]==prim.loc[i,"human_aa"] else 0 for c in spcols] for i in prim.index])
ax.imshow(Mx.T,cmap=ListedColormap(["#c0392b","#1b6ca8"]),aspect="auto",vmin=0,vmax=1)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(spcols)))
ax.set_yticklabels(["P. troglodytes","G. gorilla","T. gelada","M. mulatta","C. jacchus"],fontsize=8)
ax.set_xticks(range(len(prim)))
ax.set_xticklabels([f"{a}{b}" for a,b in zip(prim.human_aa,prim.PLAP_mature)],rotation=90,fontsize=6.5)
for k,(i,row) in enumerate(prim.iterrows()):
    if row.n_conserved<row.n_primates: ax.get_xticklabels()[k].set_color("#c0392b")
ax.set_title("c  Catalytic and specificity positions across primate ALPP-cluster orthologs\n     blue = same as human ALPP; 26/29 invariant",fontsize=10,loc="left")

# (d) the three differences
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,1]); ax.axis("off")
d6=shell[(shell.shell=="<=6A")]
txt=[
 "d  What actually differs between the ALPP and ALPL active sites",
 "",
 "≤6 Å shell: 23/26 residues identical.  All Zn1, Zn2, Mg3 ligands, the",
 "catalytic Ser92 and the Arg166 phosphate anchor are identical and",
 "superimpose to <0.5 Å.  Metal positions after superposition:",
 "   Zn2 0.17 Å, Zn1 0.34 Å, Mg3 1.31 Å apart.",
 "",
 "The three differences (PLAP mature / TNAP mature numbering):",
 "   Gly93   / Ala94    4.7 Å from the core;  Ala in gorilla, macaque,",
 "                      gelada and marmoset, so Gly is human/chimp-specific",
 "   Ser155  / Thr156   Mg3 ligand, one methyl group",
 "   Glu429  / His434   6.0 Å from the core; known determinant of",
 "                      levamisole and theophylline binding (PMID 15476587)",
 "",
 "Nearby second shell (6-10 Å): Phe107/Glu108 and Gln108/Gly109,",
 "the residues Kozlenkov et al. showed control L-homoarginine",
 "sensitivity. Tyr367 (TNAP Tyr371), which reaches across the dimer",
 "interface to 5.6 Å of the partner's catalytic core, is identical.",
 "",
 "All known PLAP/TNAP active-site differences map to uncompetitive",
 "inhibitor binding, not to phosphomonoester substrate class."]
ax.text(0,1,"\n".join(txt),va="top",ha="left",fontsize=9.1,family="DejaVu Sans",linespacing=1.45)
plt.show()
